pilot_data: Three actual root-admitted raw/static receipt pairs. Prior view omits only the later WhatsApp static receipt; current view includes it. Upstream Snapchat XAPK SHA remains a separate identity.
pilot_result: Prior exact anti-join yields only com.whatsapp/c4260c...; current anti-join yields no missing phase among three samples; registered Snapchat a37383... is not conflated with universal 77c0ff...

limitations: This is a three-artifact local replay, not a complete 114-APK receipt graph or proof of startup. WhatsApp raw package binding relies on the later host metadata/GAP-AUDIT, not its original raw admission alone.
